description: This file defines a Java class 'TaxGroupMappingsData' which is a data holder class for tax group mappings, including fields such as id, taxComponent, startDate, and endDate. It provides methods to check if a date occurs within the date range and to retrieve start and end dates.

classes.name: TaxGroupMappingsData
classes.description: A data class representing tax group mappings with associated date range and tax component information.

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndUpToAndIncluding
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the start and end date range, inclusive.

methods.name: startDate
methods.description: Returns the start date, or null if not set.

methods.name: endDate
methods.description: Returns the end date, or null if not set.
